description: Send the seller's reply to a buyer who messaged about one of the authenticated user's listings. Takes the id of one of the seller's enquiries. The buyer is notified, and the message tells them an AI assistant sent it on the seller's behalf. Requires OAuth scope `enquiries:respond`. Example: 'reply to my latest enquiry saying it's still available, collection only'.

answer.description: Reply text, as the seller would write it.

enquiryId.description: The id of one of the seller's enquiries.

name: respond_to_enquiry
